message: include path V_path escapes the include root
why: Include paths must stay inside the project. A path containing '.' or '..' lets a header reach outside the tree — which breaks reproducible builds (the resolved path depends on where the source tree happens to sit) and makes an offline build read files nobody declared.
fix: use a path relative to the include root: V_suggestion
or add the directory with -I and include it by its name inside that root
